title: Strategy removal strands accumulated yield
justification: Value leak with stated assumptions: removeYieldStrategy lacks zero-pending-yield check. Phlimbo loses pending yield from the removed strategy permanently; if the strategy is later re-added, the first claimer captures the entire unclaimed backlog as a windfall. Owner action required (matches documented trust scope of strategy registration), but the architectural gap (no force-claim or zero-yield gate) is the in-scope defect.
preconditions: Owner removes strategy with non-zero pending yield (legitimate operational scenario).
impact: Phlimbo loses accrued yield; on re-addition, single MEV claimer wins the backlog windfall.
attack_path_summary: 1) Owner calls removeYieldStrategy on a strategy with pending yield. 2) Yield strands (no claim path). 3) On re-addition (later), first claim captures full backlog.
